messages:
Jamie: quick midday standup — did: rolled the kv-cache TTL tweak to a small canary (eu-west). saw no immediate correctness regressions.
Matt: nice. any tail-latency wobble?
Jamie: slight p95 bump on embeddings route during the canary, ~40ms. not huge but worth watching.
Sara: oncall note: we had a transient alert at 09:12 UTC for eu-west model-worker OOM, auto-resolved. logs point to llama-runner process memory spike.
Jamie: OOMs on canary? did you pause rollout?
Sara: paused it as a precaution. created a short snapshot: S3://redwood-ops/snapshots/oom-euw-203912.
Riyad: I kicked a node spin-up for eu-west (requested extra g4s). @Matt can you approve the temporary scale-up? :thumbsup:
Matt: approved, go ahead. we need capacity to isolate whether it's noisy neighbor or memory leak.
Ellen: blocker: infra CR for the TTL tweak is awaiting one more review, it's tiny but affects cache eviction. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432
Jamie: tagging that as priority — if we can't get the CR merged we can't continue canary.
Matt: I'll take the review in ~20m.
Jamie: SLO check: embeddings latency SLO (99th < 350ms) is at 98.9% for the 12h window after the change. target is 99.5%.
Sara: filed SRE-1247 to track the incident + followups (alerts tuning, mem limits, canary policy).
oncall-bot: Reminder: rotation swap scheduled at 17:00 UTC.
Riyad: command I ran to spot-check pods: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
``` shows one model-worker with RestartCount=3, node eu-west-2.
Ellen: left a tiny comment on the CR about a nil-check and a log message, will push a fix.
Jamie: plan for rest of day: (1) address Ellen's comment and re-run canary, (2) let infra bring up extra node and re-observe, (3) if p95 > 300ms after scale -> rollback.
Matt: action: I will review CR and help with rollback plan if needed.
Sara: oncall will monitor alerts and escalate to infra if OOMs persist.
Jamie: anyone free to pair for a quick smoke test after I push the fix? @Matt @Sara
Matt: I can in ~10.
Sara: can join too. watching alerts.
Jamie: thanks all — will update thread when canary resumed or rolled back. :white_check_mark:
